subject: RM_Durrok
departures: No head or neck visible at all: the front end is a blunt, featureless mound of hair with no horns, eyes, ears, muzzle or face
Long, pale, glossy hair hanging in heavy, wet-looking ropes or cords all the way to the ground, hiding the body's outline
Mats of grey-green lichen in drifts across the back, shoulders and legs, with loose strands trailing where they slip
No real tail: behind it there is only a tail-like fall of white cords
Low, barrel-shaped body on four short, thick legs that barely show under the hair, so it looks like a soaked haystack
